title: He Was the Last One In… What the 21st Man Told ISIS on That Beach
description:
21 men on a beach in Libya, February 2015. 20 were Egyptian Coptic Christians. The 21st, Matthew Ayariga, wasn't from their country or their church. When he was asked about his faith, his answer is still told around the world: "Their God is my God."

This is the true story of the 21 Martyrs of Libya, told straight. No graphic footage. Just what these men did with the worst moment of their lives, and what it means for you.

"Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven." Matthew 10:32 (KJV)
